title: SKE Crystal Plus Berry Lemonade Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Berry Lemonade flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods combine a medley of sweet, juicy mixed berries with a crisp, zesty lemonade finish for a refreshing and uplifting vape. The tangy citrus sparkle perfectly balances the luscious sweetness of the berries, delivering a bright and satisfying all-day flavour. Exclusively compatible with the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods offer the iconic crystalline design of SKE Crystal Bars while providing a more sustainable and convenient alternative. The sleek and hassle-free design ensures there’s no need for refilling or coil changes—simply replace the pod and continue vaping. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for a smoother throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction. The integrated 1.1ohm mesh coil enhances flavour and provides a rich mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping experience that’s perfect for nic salt and 50/50 e-liquids. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
